items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: he was approached by Tony Martin — do you remember that name, Tony Martin, the singer?

ctx.x: Yeah well he had nice things to say about you, that you were willing to pay, you were willing to make the concessions of dues toward the end of playing quality music.

Yeah. That meant a lot to him. With Bill it was always about commitment. He used to say, you know talent is cheap, what really is required is the willingness to be dedicated to this and to stick with it, you know, to really invest yourself into the music. To make — this is not something you do lightheartedly. And this gets back to what you were asking me initially about my students and do I actually say to them the reality of what it’s going to be like to be a jazz musician. Bill knew that only too well. I mean…
